The key must begin and end with a letter (regardless of case) or a number, but can contain dashes or underscores in between. input string The resource name of an existing input, in the form of: projects/{project}/locations/{location}/inputs/{inputId} . automaticFailover object ( AutomaticFailover ) Automatic failover configurations.
The API will generate an output FPS that is divisible by the input FPS, and smaller or equal to the target FPS.
